A particle performing SHM starts equilibrium position and its time period is 16 seconds. After 2 seconds its velocity is πm/s . Amplitude of oscillation is (cos45° = 1/(√(2)))

(A) 2√(2 m)
(B) 4√(2 m)
(C) 6√(2 m)
(D) 8√(2 m)

STORED ANSWER KEY: "D"

STORED SOLUTION:
Given, particle velocity, v = πm/s and time period T = 16 s

Displacement of the particle, x = Asinωt Velocity of the particle,

v − (dx)/(dt) − Aωcosωt

Angular velocity,

ω = (2π)/T = (2π)/16 = π/8 = rad/s

Now from eq. (i),

π = A×π/8×cosπ/8×2

1 = A/8cosπ/4 = A/8·1/(√(2))

∴ A = 8√(2) m
